title: Placement Prep: Aptitude and Coding Rounds
description: Final-year students who cleared recent campus drives walk through the aptitude test, the coding round and the group discussion, with time for questions.

title: Git and GitHub for First Years
description: Bring a laptop. By the end you will have a repository, a pull request and a working understanding of merge conflicts.

title: 24-Hour Hackathon Kickoff
description: Form teams of up to four, pick a problem statement and start building. Food and power strips provided.

title: Open Mic Night
description: Music, poetry and stand-up. Sign up at the door to perform; everyone else just turns up.

title: Inter-Hostel Football Finals
description: The two unbeaten hostel teams meet for the trophy. Entry is free; registering just helps us plan the stands.

title: Robotics Club Demo Day
description: Live demos of this semester's builds, with time to ask the teams how they did it.

title: Talk: From Campus to Startup
description: An alumnus who left a placement offer to start a company talks about what the first two years were really like.

title: Alumni Fireside Chat
description: A small-room conversation about first jobs and second thoughts. Very limited seating.
